name: Desktop OS
rationale: Live arena: the platform every other tool runs on, and a classic religious war.
aiEraAngle: Which OS is the best cockpit for local agents: scriptability, permissions model, package ecosystems.

name: Startup Banking
rationale: Live arena: every startup picks one in week one.
aiEraAngle: API-first banking and spend data that AI finance agents can read and act on.

name: Project Management
rationale: Live arena: the canonical B2B SaaS battle.
aiEraAngle: Agents file, triage, and close tickets; MCP servers and webhook depth separate the field.

name: Web Scraping APIs
rationale: Live arena: the web-to-structured-data layer every agent stack needs.
aiEraAngle: LLM-ready output formats, anti-bot resilience, and per-token economics of feeding agents the web.

name: Mobile AI Dev Tools
rationale: Live arena: running and steering coding agents from a phone.
aiEraAngle: The category exists because agents keep working while you walk away from the desk.

name: Code Hosting
rationale: Live arena: where all software lives.
aiEraAngle: Agent-driven PRs, Actions/CI as agent runtime, and API/webhook depth for automated contribution.

name: AI Coding Agents
rationale: Live arena: the defining tool battle of the AI era.
aiEraAngle: Agents judging agents: autonomy, codebase understanding, safety of unsupervised changes.

name: Edge & App Platforms
g2Equivalent: Cloud Platform as a Service (PaaS) Software
rationale: Live arena: where AI-built apps get deployed.
aiEraAngle: Deploy-by-agent workflows: CLIs, provisioning APIs, and free-tier headroom for generated apps.

name: Frontend Frameworks
rationale: Live arena: the eternal JavaScript framework war.
aiEraAngle: Which framework LLMs generate best: training-data gravity, llms.txt docs, type-safety guardrails.

name: Local LLM Runtimes
rationale: Live arena: run models on your own hardware.
aiEraAngle: Privacy-preserving inference and OpenAI-compatible local endpoints for agent stacks.

name: Product Feedback & Intent
rationale: Live arena: turning user intent into buildable work.
aiEraAngle: Feedback-to-task pipelines that coding agents can consume directly.

name: Agent Frameworks & SDKs
g2Equivalent: Agentic AI Software / AI Orchestration Software
rationale: The 'which framework do I build my agent on' question every team asks first.
aiEraAngle: Scored on tool/MCP support, durable state, human-in-the-loop primitives, and lock-in risk.

name: MCP Infrastructure
rationale: Live arena: the registry/gateway/auth layer for the protocol our whole scoring spine assumes. mcp.run was evaluated and excluded (pivoted to demo-gated Turbo MCP; no public docs or registry API left to verify).
aiEraAngle: Meta-category: infrastructure whose product is agent-readiness itself.

name: Agent Skills & Extensions
rationale: Live arena: the skills/plugins layer every coding agent now loads — packaged instructions became the unit of agent knowledge. Ultrametric placement (founder decision 2026-10-08, the site's own product entered as a judged vendor): agent-skills over legal-ops, mcp-infrastructure, and notes-knowledge, decided on story fit. Ultrametric ships packaged agent instructions — `ultrametric init` installs a plain SKILL.md into .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/ with a --dry-run preview, and the hosted process guides are the instructions the skill dispatches to — so the install/portability/inspection stories and the agentic CLI/MCP/API block test its actual claims, and the thin-collection negatives (no catalog, no selective install, no authoring tooling) are real findings. legal-ops matches the guides' subject matter (incorporation, EIN, hiring) but its execution-shaped stories (filings, e-signature, registered agent) would verdict none for structural reasons — Ultrametric executes nothing by design (docs/SELF-EVAL.md reached the same conclusion). mcp-infrastructure's taxonomy tests platforms that host, publish, and gate downstream MCP servers; Ultrametric runs one first-party server and provides none of the platform functions. notes-knowledge tests personal knowledge tools (graph, wiki links, sync); mapping the company-record stores onto it would credit and penalize the wrong claims. Owner-product rules apply: disclosed on the record, adversarially bias-audited, honest negatives published (the Instinct precedent).
aiEraAngle: Skill content and distribution tooling head-to-head: install UX, authoring, portability across harnesses, and whether an agent can install a skill for itself.

name: Vibe-Coding App Builders
rationale: Live arena: prompt-to-app builders are the fastest-growing dev category; G2 has no clean home for them.
aiEraAngle: Full-stack generation quality, export/eject openness, and deploy pipelines judged head-to-head.

name: Model Gateways & Routers
rationale: Live arena: one API over every model — routing, fallbacks, caching, spend control.
aiEraAngle: The traffic layer of the agent economy; uptime, latency overhead, and provider neutrality are testable.

name: LLM Evals & Observability
rationale: Nobody ships agents to production without tracing and evals; G2 buries this in MLOps.
aiEraAngle: OTel-compatible tracing, dataset/eval APIs, and self-hostability are the whole product.

name: Agent Sandboxes & Code Execution
rationale: Safe execution for untrusted agent-generated code; brand-new category G2 lacks entirely.
aiEraAngle: Cold-start latency, filesystem/network isolation, and per-second pricing under agent-scale fan-out.

name: AI Search APIs
rationale: Search built for LLM consumption, not blue links; a top-3 tool call in every agent.
aiEraAngle: Result quality for RAG, citation fidelity, rate limits, and cost-per-thousand-queries.

name: AI Memory Layers
rationale: Persistent memory across sessions is the next agent battleground; no G2 equivalent.
aiEraAngle: Recall precision, memory-write APIs, privacy/erasure guarantees, portability of the memory graph.

name: Voice Agent Platforms
rationale: Phone and voice automation is the biggest near-term agent deployment surface.
aiEraAngle: Latency, barge-in handling, telephony integration, and tool-calling mid-conversation.

name: Autonomous Coding Agents
rationale: Splits from the live ai-coding arena: ticket-to-PR autonomy vs supervised pairing are different products.
aiEraAngle: Unsupervised task completion rate, PR quality, and cost-per-merged-change.

name: AI Code Review
rationale: Live arena: with agents writing most new code, the AI reviewer became the load-bearing quality gate — and its own product war.
aiEraAngle: Signal-to-noise of findings, CI/webhook depth, and behavior reviewing agent-authored diffs.

name: Frontier Model APIs
rationale: The most consequential vendor choice in modern software; deserves evidence-based scoring.
aiEraAngle: Tool-use reliability, context economics, caching, rate-limit reality vs published numbers.

name: Open-Model Inference Providers
rationale: Serving open weights fast and cheap is its own market distinct from frontier labs.
aiEraAngle: Tokens/sec, cold starts, OpenAI-compat fidelity, and price-performance per model family.

name: Open-Weight LLMs
rationale: The models themselves are products teams standardize on; classic battle with real evidence.
aiEraAngle: License openness, tool-calling quality, quantization ecosystem, hosting breadth.

name: Vector Databases
rationale: Core retrieval infrastructure for every RAG and memory system.
aiEraAngle: Recall/latency trade-offs, hybrid search, serverless pricing, self-host escape hatch.

name: Package & Toolchain Managers
rationale: Every developer and every coding agent installs dependencies; reproducibility and supply-chain posture decide trust.
aiEraAngle: Headless installs with structured errors, machine-readable lockfiles, --json outputs, llms.txt/agent docs.

name: Browser Automation for Agents
rationale: Live arena, split from web-scraping: acting on the web (forms, checkout, flows) vs extracting data from it. Browserbase stays in web-scraping (cloud browser infra for extraction); Stagehand, its OSS agent framework, competes here. Playwright excluded: general test automation, not an agent layer.
aiEraAngle: Session persistence, captcha/anti-bot posture, auditability of agent actions.

name: Document Extraction APIs
rationale: Live arena: every agent pipeline starts by reading documents, and the parse/extract layer decides what the model ever sees.
aiEraAngle: Table/layout fidelity, schema-directed extraction, cost per thousand pages.

name: Workflow Automation
rationale: Classic Zapier-vs-Make battle, redrawn by AI-native entrants and self-hosted n8n.
aiEraAngle: LLM steps as first-class primitives; whether the tool is itself agent-drivable via API/MCP.

name: Durable Execution Engines
rationale: Live arena: durable execution is the backbone under serious agent systems — multi-day agent runs need checkpointed retries, human-in-the-loop waits, and replay debugging.
aiEraAngle: Agent-loop ergonomics, human-in-the-loop waits, replay/debugging of multi-day runs.

name: AI Assistants
rationale: Live arena: the most-used software products on earth, finally judged on evidence. Now spans frontier-lab assistants plus the personal-first wave (Meta Muse, Poke, Martin) brought up 2026-09.
aiEraAngle: Connectors/MCP support, memory, deep research, and data-control/privacy posture.

name: Personal AI Assistants & Companions
rationale: 2026-09 research verdict: the strongest personal assistants (Meta Muse, Poke, Martin) compete honestly in the live ai-assistants arena and were brought up there instead. What remains is a companion/concierge tier - Pi (alive but no dev surface; pi.ai bot-blocks fetchers), Sesame (voice preview, eyewear 2027), Ohai (family manager, from $9.99/mo), Duckbill (human+AI concierge, $49-350/mo), Rabbit r1 ($199 device), Friend (companion pendant). Dead/pivoted, verified 2026-09-14: Dot shut down Oct 2025; Limitless acquired by Meta and sunsetting; Personal.ai pivoted to enterprise telecom. Stand this arena up only if judged as its own thing (companionship, proactivity, household focus) rather than on the assistants spine, where most of these would na/none out (Mercury-SAFEs rule).
aiEraAngle: Proactive outreach, memory, and real-world task completion (calls, bookings, purchases) vs privacy posture; almost no public APIs - the absence is the finding.

name: AI Customer Support Agents
rationale: Live arena: the first agent category with real enterprise revenue and resolution-rate claims to audit. Forethought was dropped (acquired by Zendesk, Mar 2026) and Ada (hard bot-wall, stale funding) in favor of Pylon, Lorikeet, and Parahelp.
aiEraAngle: Verifiable deflection/resolution rates, escalation safety, per-resolution pricing.

name: Enterprise AI Search & Work Assistants
rationale: Company-knowledge assistants are the top enterprise AI purchase of 2025-26.
aiEraAngle: Connector breadth, permission-aware retrieval, and whether external agents can query it.

name: Meeting AI & Notetakers
rationale: Live arena: ubiquitous adoption, sharp product differences, heavy privacy stakes.
aiEraAngle: Notes-as-API for downstream agents, bot-free capture, retention/consent policies.

name: AI Search Visibility (GEO/AEO)
rationale: SEO's successor: being cited by ChatGPT/Perplexity is the new ranking on Google.
aiEraAngle: Measurement methodology transparency in a category about being seen by AI.

name: Browsers (AI Era)
rationale: The browser war reopened for the first time in a decade, driven by agentic browsing — though ChatGPT Atlas already came and went (shut down Aug 2026, folded into the ChatGPT desktop app), so this arena needs evidence, not vibes.
aiEraAngle: Built-in agents, page-context APIs, and the privacy cost of an AI that sees every tab.

name: Search Engines
rationale: Answer engines are eating the ten blue links; the incumbent battle of the decade.
aiEraAngle: AI-answer quality vs link quality, index independence, API access for agents.

name: Managed Postgres
rationale: Postgres won; the fight is now branching, serverless scale-to-zero, and DX.
aiEraAngle: Instant branch-per-agent databases and provisioning APIs built for generated apps.

name: Serverless & Developer Databases
rationale: Live arena: the database is the first piece of infrastructure every app and every agent-built app provisions.
aiEraAngle: Branch-per-agent workflows, scale-to-zero economics for fleets of generated apps, and MCP/CLI surfaces that let agents provision and operate databases headlessly.

name: Auth & Identity Platforms
rationale: Every generated app needs auth in the first hour; vibe-coding tools default-pick winners.
aiEraAngle: Agent/token auth patterns, M2M pricing, and self-host openness vs per-MAU lock-in.

name: Observability & Monitoring
rationale: The Datadog-bill rebellion is a classic battle with huge search volume.
aiEraAngle: Query APIs and MCP servers that let agents debug production; OTel-native openness.

name: Team Chat
rationale: Slack vs Teams is the most-searched workplace software comparison alive.
aiEraAngle: Chat is becoming the agent UI: bot APIs, MCP surface, and self-host options decide it.

name: Backend as a Service
rationale: Default backend for AI-generated apps; Supabase vs Firebase is a top comparison query.
aiEraAngle: Provisioning by agent, typed client generation, and open-source escape hatches.

name: Payments Infrastructure
rationale: Stripe-vs-everyone; merchant-of-record entrants changed the calculus.
aiEraAngle: Agentic commerce readiness: programmatic onboarding, usage-based primitives, ACP/x402 posture.

name: Agentic Commerce
rationale: Live arena: agents buying things stopped being a demo in 2026 — UCP, ACP, MPP, and x402 all shipped with real developer surfaces, and the processors, platforms, and one card network productized them. Mastercard Agent Pay stayed announcement-tier (no public spec, sandbox, or SDK) and Google AP2 is a spec with samples, not a product — both excluded with notes in the arena description.
aiEraAngle: The category is agent-native by definition: keyless UCP handshakes and real cart creation on Shopify, Stripe’s MPP/x402 machine payments and Link agent wallet, PayPal’s remote MCP and Agentic Commerce Cart API, Visa’s published Trusted Agent Protocol, Coinbase’s keyless x402 Bazaar, Crossmint’s agent cards and checkouts, Skyfire’s KYA identity tokens — all probed live.

name: Agent Identity & Tool Auth
rationale: OAuth-for-agents: delegated, scoped credentials for tool calling.
aiEraAngle: Token scoping, consent flows, and revocation when the principal is a model.

name: Billing & Subscriptions
rationale: Live arena: usage-based and hybrid pricing made billing hard again, and the market consolidated around it — Stripe bought Metronome (Dec 2025), Adyen bought Orb (Jul 2026); Chargebee and Lago (AGPLv3) are the independents, Recurly the PE-owned subscriptions specialist.
aiEraAngle: Metering per-token/per-agent-action workloads, and agent access to billing state: Lago answers a keyless MCP initialize, Stripe/Chargebee/Recurly ship OAuth-gated MCP servers, and every serious vendor now serves llms.txt and .md doc twins.

name: Transactional Email APIs
rationale: Live arena (founder ask 2026-09-23): SendGrid appears on 6 untracked process-step chips and the category owns the send layer under every launch checklist. Loops stays tracked in email-marketing rather than being double-counted.
aiEraAngle: Resend ships llms.txt + OpenAPI + a hosted MCP server + published agent skills; Mailgun documents an MCP server; the arena measures whether an agent can authenticate a domain and send end to end.

name: CPaaS & Messaging APIs
rationale: Voice/SMS rails under every voice-agent deployment.
aiEraAngle: Programmable telephony as agent actuator; number provisioning by API.

name: CDN & Edge Networks
rationale: The layer that decides whether agents and crawlers reach the web at all.
aiEraAngle: Bot management now gatekeeps agent traffic: pay-per-crawl, verified-agent programs.

name: Object Storage
rationale: Egress-fee rebellion vs S3 gravity; clean evidence-based comparison.
aiEraAngle: Zero-egress economics for model/data pipelines; S3-compat fidelity for agent tooling.

name: In-Memory Caches & KV Stores
rationale: The Redis license fork made this a genuine contest again.
aiEraAngle: Session/memory state for agents; serverless pricing under bursty agent load.

name: Queues & Event Streaming
rationale: Backbone of async architectures; Kafka-compatible challengers are credible now.
aiEraAngle: Event-driven agent triggers; protocol openness vs managed convenience.

name: Data Warehouses & Lakehouses
rationale: Live arena: the center of gravity of the modern data stack — every analytics dollar flows through one of these.
aiEraAngle: Agents running governed SQL: MCP servers, AI SQL assistants, keyless local dev loops, and cost isolation for unpredictable agent workloads.

name: Data Pipelines & ELT
rationale: Live arena: connector economics (MAR pricing) vs open source is a live fight; absorbs the orchestration boundary via Dagster as the data-asset anchor.
aiEraAngle: AI connector builders, MCP servers over pipelines, and agents that scaffold and run a pipeline end to end via CLI/API.

name: Data Orchestration
rationale: Airflow's successor fight; strongly opinionated communities. (Dagster is already live in the data-pipelines arena.)
aiEraAngle: Asset lineage agents can reason over; declarative pipelines as agent targets.

name: BI & Analytics Platforms
rationale: Self-serve BI vs governed BI, plus open-source challengers.
aiEraAngle: Natural-language querying and whether dashboards expose APIs agents can read.

name: Product Analytics
rationale: PostHog's all-in-one play vs specialized incumbents.
aiEraAngle: Query APIs, warehouse-native openness, LLM-analytics features.

name: Web Analytics
rationale: GA4 backlash created a real privacy-first market.
aiEraAngle: Privacy posture and clean stats APIs for agent-generated reports.

name: Feature Flags & Experimentation
rationale: Commoditizing fast — pricing and open source drive switching.
aiEraAngle: Flags as the safety rail for shipping agent-written code progressively.

name: Experimentation Platforms
rationale: Warehouse-native challengers upended legacy A/B suites.
aiEraAngle: Experiment APIs that agents can register and read results from.

name: Error Tracking
rationale: Live arena: the field consolidated around Sentry, whose FSL license and AI push (Seer) reset the terms of the category — BugSnag went through a SmartBear "Insight Hub" rebrand and back, Airbrake has been frozen since mid-2024 under LogicMonitor, and GlitchTip carries the MIT-licensed Sentry-compatible self-host flag.
aiEraAngle: Agent access to production errors: Sentry and Honeybadger run hosted OAuth-gated MCP servers, GlitchTip ships MCP built into the product, Rollbar and Raygun publish stdio MCP servers — and Sentry Seer/Rollbar Resolve turn an issue into a reviewed pull request.

name: Incident Management & On-call
rationale: Live arena: Opsgenie's sunset forced a mass migration and buyers are actively comparing. Opsgenie itself was verified sunset (Atlassian's page redirects to a migration notice) and Grafana OnCall OSS was verified archived (repo moved to grafana-cold-storage), so Better Stack fills the fifth slot from the roadmap's own candidate list.
aiEraAngle: AI responders head-to-head: AI incident summaries and drafted postmortems (incident.io Scribe, Rootly AI, FireHydrant AI), root-cause investigations, and hosted MCP servers (mcp.pagerduty.com, mcp.incident.io, mcp.rootly.com) through which agents ack and escalate.

name: Customer Data Platforms
rationale: Live arena: the pipe every other tool drinks from — Segment vs open-source RudderStack/Jitsu vs the composable-CDP wave (Hightouch), with mParticle judged post-Rokt-merger. Amplitude stays in product-analytics (boundary rule: products judged here only on their CDP surface).
aiEraAngle: Agents managing customer-data pipelines head-to-head: hosted MCP servers verified live for RudderStack (mcp.rudderstack.com), Jitsu (use.jitsu.com/mcp), and Hightouch; AI audience builders and agent-driven activation judged against evidence; llms.txt sweep across all five.

name: CI/CD Platforms
rationale: Compute pricing and speed created credible Actions alternatives.
aiEraAngle: CI as the agent's test harness: API-triggered runs, log access, ephemeral environments.

name: Infrastructure as Code
rationale: The BSL license fork made Terraform vs OpenTofu a genuine governance battle.
aiEraAngle: Declarative infra is the natural agent interface; plan/apply APIs and state security.

name: Secrets Management
rationale: Every agent deployment multiplies credential surface area.
aiEraAngle: Short-lived credentials for agents; audit trails of non-human access.

name: Managed Kubernetes
rationale: Still the default substrate for serious infra; real operational differences.
aiEraAngle: Cluster APIs agents can operate; GPU scheduling for inference workloads.

name: GPU Clouds
rationale: The neocloud land grab; pricing and availability change monthly.
aiEraAngle: Spot economics, provisioning APIs, and per-GPU-hour truth vs marketing.

name: Developer VPS Clouds
rationale: The Hetzner-value meme is real; classic price-performance battle.
aiEraAngle: API-provisioned cheap compute as agent runtime; egress pricing honesty.

name: Hyperscaler Clouds
rationale: The biggest procurement decision in software; deserves evidence over lore.
aiEraAngle: AI service depth, quota/API friction for agents, and egress/lock-in posture.

name: API Clients & Testing
rationale: Postman fatigue birthed an offline/open-source revolt.
aiEraAngle: Git-native collections agents can read; local-first vs cloud-sync privacy.

name: API Gateways & Management
rationale: Every exposed API needs one; AI-gateway features are converging in.
aiEraAngle: Rate-limiting and auth for agent consumers; MCP endpoint publishing.

name: SDK & API Tooling Generators
rationale: OpenAPI-to-SDK became table stakes for API companies.
aiEraAngle: These tools now emit MCP servers and agent tool definitions from specs.

name: Cloud Development Environments
rationale: CDEs are being reborn as homes for parallel coding agents.
aiEraAngle: Prebuilt, disposable environments as agent workspaces; per-hour economics.

name: Code Security (SAST)
rationale: AI-generated code volume makes automated scanning existential.
aiEraAngle: Scanning agent-written diffs in CI; rule openness and false-positive economics.

name: Software Supply Chain Security
rationale: npm attacks and slopsquatting made dependency vetting urgent.
aiEraAngle: Agents install packages autonomously; the guard rail must be API-native.

name: Zero-Trust Networking & VPN
rationale: Tailscale redefined the category; classic incumbent-vs-insurgent.
aiEraAngle: Secure network paths for distributed agents and home-lab inference.

name: Password Managers
rationale: High-volume consumer/prosumer comparison with real security evidence.
aiEraAngle: Passkeys, CLI/SDK access for agent credential brokering, breach transparency.

name: E2E & Browser Testing
rationale: Playwright's takeover is recent enough that teams are actively migrating.
aiEraAngle: The same tooling drives agent browser control; AI test generation and self-healing.

name: Internal Tool Builders
rationale: Being squeezed by vibe-coding from below and agents from above — great story.
aiEraAngle: AI app generation inside the builder; self-host openness vs per-seat pricing.

name: Realtime Infrastructure
rationale: WebRTC/WebSocket rails under voice agents and collaborative apps.
aiEraAngle: Voice-agent transport is the growth engine; latency and SDK truth.

name: Search Infrastructure
rationale: Live arena: every product with more than a page of content ships a search box, and the engines behind it are a classic OSS-vs-SaaS battle.
aiEraAngle: Hybrid vector+keyword relevance, agents that create and query indexes headlessly via CLI/API/MCP, and search-as-a-tool for RAG stacks.

name: Headless CMS
rationale: Content APIs for the modern stack; Payload's open-source rise.
aiEraAngle: Content as structured data agents can write; schema APIs and webhooks.

name: Developer Docs Platforms
rationale: Live arena: docs are now read by agents more than humans, and these vendors sell the agent-docs layer this site scores everyone on.
aiEraAngle: llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, MCP docs servers — the category's new scoreboard.

name: Website Builders
rationale: Massive market being re-segmented by AI site generation.
aiEraAngle: AI generation quality, code export, and programmatic site APIs.

name: E-commerce Platforms
rationale: Live arena: Shopify vs open-source (WooCommerce, Medusa) vs API-first challengers (BigCommerce, Swell) — huge switching-cost decisions. All five verified live, including Swell (actively shipping, 'commerce infrastructure for AI agents' positioning).
aiEraAngle: Agent commerce head-to-head: Shopify's Universal Commerce Protocol (Global Catalog MCP + per-storefront /api/ucp/mcp, both verified with keyless initialize handshakes, plus the @shopify/ucp-cli), WooCommerce's native MCP integration (WordPress Abilities API), Medusa's Cloud-gated remote MCP, BigCommerce's docs MCP, and Swell's agent skills marketplace — agentic checkout and catalog-for-agents claims judged against evidence.

name: Code Editors & IDEs
rationale: Distinct from AI-coding arena: the editor substrate itself (Zed vs VS Code performance war).
aiEraAngle: Extension APIs for agent integration; local performance under AI feature load.

name: Terminal Emulators
rationale: Ghostty and Warp made terminals exciting again.
aiEraAngle: The terminal is the agent cockpit; AI features vs privacy of shell history.

name: Design & Prototyping
rationale: Live arena: the design-tool battle — Figma's platform gravity vs Penpot's open-source, self-hostable challenge (MPL, official docker compose with a first-party MCP service), with Framer, Sketch, and Canva fighting from the site-builder, Mac-craft, and visual-suite corners.
aiEraAngle: Design context for coding agents: hosted MCP servers (mcp.figma.com, mcp.canva.com, Penpot self-hosted MCP), plugin APIs agents can drive, and NL-to-design claims judged against evidence.

name: Docs & Team Workspaces
rationale: Notion vs Confluence is a perennial top comparison.
aiEraAngle: Workspace APIs/MCP as agent knowledge substrate; export openness.

name: Notes & Knowledge Bases
rationale: Live arena: passionate community, sharp local-first vs cloud divide. Notion is judged in Project Management; Roam verified still shipping but excluded for now (thin crawlable docs).
aiEraAngle: Plain-text vaults are natively agent-readable; plugin/URI automation depth.

name: CRM
rationale: The largest B2B software category; Attio's rise gives it a fresh story.
aiEraAngle: CRM data as agent context; API depth vs seat-license lock-in.

name: Help Desk & Shared Inbox
rationale: Under direct disruption from the AI-support-agents arena above.
aiEraAngle: Ticket APIs and webhook depth determine how far AI resolution can go.

name: AI SDR & Outbound Agents
rationale: Loud, contested category where marketing claims badly need evidence.
aiEraAngle: Verifiable reply/meeting rates vs hype; deliverability collateral damage.

name: Fine-Tuning Platforms
rationale: Distillation from frontier to cheap open models is a durable workflow.
aiEraAngle: Data pipelines, LoRA serving, and eval integration measured end-to-end.

name: RAG Frameworks & Pipelines
rationale: Retrieval quality is the difference between demo and product.
aiEraAngle: Chunking/retrieval benchmarks, observability hooks, lock-in of abstractions.

name: Embedding & Reranking APIs
rationale: Quiet but critical layer under every retrieval system.
aiEraAngle: MTEB-style evidence vs marketing; dimension/cost trade-offs; open-weight options.

name: AI Guardrails & LLM Security
rationale: Prompt injection is unsolved; every serious deployment needs a layer here.
aiEraAngle: Measured jailbreak catch rates, latency overhead, policy-as-code APIs.

name: Speech-to-Text APIs
rationale: Feeds the entire voice-agent stack; WER claims deserve auditing.
aiEraAngle: Streaming latency, diarization, real WER on messy audio, self-host options.

name: Text-to-Speech APIs
rationale: Voice quality moved fast; pricing spread is enormous.
aiEraAngle: Latency for conversational use, voice cloning consent policy, per-character economics.

name: Image Generation Models & APIs
rationale: Promoted by the 2026 frontier-lab product mapping: every lab now ships productized image generation and editing (GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst/Flare, Nano Banana, Grok Imagine), and those lines sit page-only on family pages until this arena exists. Stories are ready to write: generate from a brief, edit with reference images, keep a character consistent, respect brand assets, drive it from an API.
aiEraAngle: Editing precision from references, API and agent access, provenance watermarking, and rights posture — capability stories, not benchmark scores.

name: Video Generation Models & APIs
rationale: The most-watched frontier of generative AI — and already consolidating: OpenAI shut the Sora app in April 2026 and retires its Videos API in Sept 2026, leaving Google Flow and Grok Imagine as the lab-shipped products.
aiEraAngle: API maturity vs consumer-app-only, cost per second, content credentials.

name: Smart Home Platforms
rationale: Home Assistant vs big-tech ecosystems is a passionate, evidence-rich fight.
aiEraAngle: The home is an agent surface: local APIs, Matter openness, voice-assistant privacy.

name: Compliance Automation
rationale: Live arena (launch-audit wave 5): every AI startup needs SOC 2 to sell — 13 process steps across 7 founder processes were pointing at untracked chips.
aiEraAngle: Evidence-collection APIs, AI questionnaire answering, MCP surfaces, and integration breadth are the axes; the compliance platform is itself becoming an agent target.

name: Data Notebooks
rationale: marimo and Hex are genuinely rethinking the notebook.
aiEraAngle: Notebooks as agent scratchpads; reactive execution and API-driven runs.

name: Session Replay & Heatmaps
rationale: Consolidating into product-analytics suites but still bought standalone.
aiEraAngle: Replay data feeding AI UX analysis; privacy masking guarantees.

name: Mobile App Frameworks
rationale: Cross-platform vs native is a perennial architecture decision.
aiEraAngle: Which stack coding agents build best; hot-reload loops for agent iteration.

name: Scheduling & Calendar
rationale: Live arena: the booking-link battle plus the AI-calendar wave. Cal.com went closed source in April 2026 — its MIT community edition lives on as the separate Cal.diy project, which anchors the self-host story. Notion Calendar was evaluated and passed over (no public API or developer surface to verify).
aiEraAngle: Scheduling is a canonical agent task: booking APIs, hosted MCP endpoints (mcp.cal.com, mcp.calendly.com, mcp.reclaim.ai), and AI auto-scheduling claims judged against evidence.

name: Email Clients & Email AI

YC entries verified by domain against the yc-oss directory: Deel W19, LegalOS W26. Evaluated and excluded: Manifest Law (bot-walls the keyless crawler, HTTP 403 site-wide — the iPostal1 precedent), Gale (YC W25 — its own llms.txt links blog posts that all 404; crawlable corpus is a single page, too thin to judge fairly), Pearl Law Group (brand shell — pearllawgroup.com redirects to a personal LinkedIn), Fragomen and Corporate Immigration Partners (enterprise mobility, not startup-focused), Boundless/Bridge (consumer family-visa-first; bridge.us 301s to boundless.com), Argo Visa (interview prep only; its llms.txt serves another company's content), Atlys (travel visas), Unshackled Ventures (a VC fund, not a service vendor), Wasden Banias (pivoted to federal immigration litigation), Legalpad (acquired, folded into Deel).
aiEraAngle: Immigration services judge near-zero on agent readiness like law firms, and the arena records that honestly — the differentiators are published flat fees (Alma, Lighthouse, Founder Law), free eligibility tools (LegalOS), and open founder guides; the only machine surfaces found are marketing llms.txt files, one of them (Gale) with dead links.

name: Government Services
candidateProducts: New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services
rationale: Live arena (founder decision 2026-10-05: try to test the untested, e.g. the IRS as a vendor — overriding the no-arena recommendation in docs/vendor-research/government-services-agenticness.md §6, which stands as the evidence foundation). These are statutory monopolies judged as vendors on their own published public pages under strict rules of engagement: keyless public pages only, standard pipeline UA, robots.txt respected on every host, no logins, no CAPTCHA interaction, no filings, no load testing.
